title: Mathematical Consistency — SymPy Symbolic Verification
description: SymPy symbolic verification of APGI core equation self-consistency. Checks monotonicity, boundary conditions, fixed points, and parameter constraints as mathematical proofs — not empirical measurements. A PASS is a proof; a FAIL means the equation as written is mathematically inconsistent with the paper claim.

sub_predictions.claim: Ignition monotonicity: dP/dS_t > 0 for all S_t (sigmoid is strictly increasing; required for all-or-none ignition claim)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: SymPy derivative is positive for all symbolic S_t values.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Derivative is zero or negative for any S_t — ignition probability is not monotone.

sub_predictions.claim: Ignition boundary: lim_{S→-inf} P = 0 and lim_{S→+inf} P = 1 (probability is properly normalised)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Both limits evaluate to the correct boundary values symbolically.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Either limit fails — probability is not bounded in (0,1).

sub_predictions.claim: Somatic precision gain: dPi_eff/dM > 0 for M in [-2, +2] (vmPFC marker M increases effective precision)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Symbolic derivative is positive across the specified domain.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Derivative is zero or negative — somatic marker does not increase precision as claimed in Paper 1 §3.2.

sub_predictions.claim: Precision baseline: Pi_eff(M=0) = Pi_base (precision equals baseline when no somatic marker signal)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Symbolic substitution M=0 yields Pi_base exactly.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Substitution yields a value different from Pi_base — identity check fails.

sub_predictions.claim: Threshold equilibrium: d-theta/dt = 0 iff S_t = theta* (adaptive threshold ODE has unique fixed point at signal equals threshold)
sub_predictions.confirming_evidence: Solving the ODE symbolically yields exactly one fixed point where S_t = theta.
sub_predictions.falsifying_evidence: Multiple fixed points or no fixed point — necessary condition for bistability claim fails.

validation_notes: All five checks are binary (True/False). A single failed check causes PROTOCOL FAIL. There is no partial-pass mode — mathematical consistency is all-or-nothing. Results are exact under stated assumptions; no sampling noise. V7a.1-V7a.5 predictions are primary-tier mathematical proofs and count in the canonical tally.

inclusion_criteria: SymPy >= 1.12 must be importable in the execution environment
APGI core equation parameters must be fully specified (no undefined symbols)
exclusion_criteria: SymPy unavailable (falls back to numerical approximation which is not a proof)
Equation parameters contain floating-point ambiguities that prevent symbolic resolution

apparatus.execution_environment: APGI desktop application and local project runtime
apparatus.notes: No hardware required. Pure symbolic computation.

target.type: Symbolic equation definition and SymPy verification pass

trial_structure.response: Boolean pass/fail for each of the 5 symbolic checks
trial_structure.session_structure: Single deterministic software execution; results are reproducible across runs

blocks.notes: 5 symbolic checks (V7a.1-V7a.5); each is a single proof, not a trial in the traditional sense.

dependent_variables: V7a.5 — threshold equilibrium fixed point: True/False
Overall mathematical consistency: all 5 checks must pass
primary_hypothesis: All five APGI core equations are mathematically self-consistent: ignition probability is strictly monotone and properly normalised, somatic marker increases precision as claimed, precision equals baseline at M=0, and the adaptive threshold ODE has a unique fixed point.
primary_analysis: SymPy symbolic verification of each equation property. Each check is evaluated as a symbolic expression and solved or differentiated analytically. No statistical test is required — these are mathematical proofs.

power_analysis.based_on: Mathematical proofs are deterministic; power analysis is not applicable but required by schema

ethics.exempt_reason: Software-only symbolic computation. No human subjects, no animal subjects, no data collection.

caveats: This is an internal consistency check, not a canonical EP protocol. There is no canonical EP-N that maps to mathematical consistency verification.
VP_07a is not a standalone empirical prediction — it is a pre-condition for VP_07 (EP-2/EP-7) validity.
FP_07_MathematicalConsistency.py is a 142KB implementation that mirrors this protocol from the falsification side.
